'''''The Wake of the Breaking''''' is a history book. [[Min]] was reading it in [[Arad Doman]] when [[Rhuarc]] and [[Bael]] arrived in the camp to make their initial report on the pacification of Arad Doman to [[Rand]].{{ref/book|12|7}}{{ref/book|c|The Wake of the Breaking|Wake of the Breaking, The}} Min's copy was probably one of [[Herid Fel]]'s books.
